summary.business_type: Developer tool / open-source component library (shadcn/ui + TanStack Table add-ons)
top_findings: Canonical tags, sitemap, and og:image all point at a host (shad-table.dev) that 307-redirects to www.shad-table.dev
sitemap.xml is missing 12 of 27 live pages (44%)
No security headers beyond HSTS (missing X-Content-Type-Options, X-Frame-Options, CSP, Referrer-Policy)
Only one JSON-LD block site-wide (homepage WebSite); no schema on any of the 27 example pages
quick_wins: Align canonical/OG/sitemap host and switch redirect to 301
Add security headers via Vercel config
Add BreadcrumbList + SoftwareSourceCode schema to shared example-page layout

categories.name: Technical SEO
what_works: robots.txt is permissive and correctly references sitemap.xml
No noindex tags found on sampled pages
Core content is server-rendered (not JS-only), safe for all crawlers

findings.title: Canonical/sitemap/OG point at a redirecting host
findings.description: https://shad-table.dev/ returns HTTP 307 to https://www.shad-table.dev/, but every canonical tag, sitemap <loc>, and og:image URL uses the shad-table.dev (redirecting) host.
findings.recommendation: Pick one canonical host and align canonical tags, sitemap, and OG/Twitter tags to it; change redirect to 301.

findings.title: Sitemap missing 44% of live pages
findings.description: 27 live 200-status pages discovered via internal link crawl; sitemap.xml lists only 16.
findings.recommendation: Regenerate sitemap.xml from the actual route manifest, ideally automated at build time.

findings.title: Temporary redirect used for permanent host preference
Missing security headers
findings.description: Only strict-transport-security present; no X-Content-Type-Options, X-Frame-Options, CSP, or Referrer-Policy.
findings.recommendation: Add baseline security headers via Vercel/Next config.

categories.name: Content Quality
what_works: Unique titles, meta descriptions, and H1s across all sampled pages
Descriptions are specific to each component, not boilerplate

findings.title: Thin unique prose per example page
findings.description: 580-840 words per page, mostly nav/UI chrome rather than page-specific explanatory text.
findings.recommendation: Add a 2-4 sentence unique intro per page describing the use case.

findings.title: Near-duplicate page topics risk cannibalization
findings.description: filter-toolbar-table, toolbar-filter-table, params-filter-table, filter-state-shape-table, and server-filter overlap conceptually.
findings.recommendation: Ensure each page's copy clearly differentiates its specific use case.

findings.title: No schema on any example page
findings.description: Only the homepage has JSON-LD (WebSite type); 27 example pages have none.
findings.recommendation: Add BreadcrumbList and SoftwareSourceCode/TechArticle schema via the shared page layout.

findings.title: Field data not measurable from this environment
findings.description: curl timing showed a flat ~10s connect time on every request regardless of asset size, indicating a sandbox network artifact rather than real site latency.
findings.recommendation: Run PageSpeed Insights / CrUX directly against https://www.shad-table.dev for trustworthy LCP/INP/CLS data.

categories.name: AI Search Readiness
what_works: robots.txt allows all crawlers including AI bots (GPTBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot)
Content is server-rendered and readable without JS execution

findings.title: No llms.txt
findings.recommendation: Add an llms.txt summarizing the product and linking to component pages.

phases.name: Phase 1: Critical Fixes
items: Align canonical host across canonical tags, sitemap, and OG tags
Regenerate sitemap.xml to include all 27 live pages

phases.name: Phase 2: High-Impact Improvements
items: Automate sitemap generation from route manifest
Add security headers (X-Content-Type-Options, X-Frame-Options, CSP, Referrer-Policy)
Add BreadcrumbList and SoftwareSourceCode/TechArticle schema to example-page layout
Run PageSpeed Insights for real CWV field data

phases.name: Phase 3: Content & Authority
items: Add unique intro copy to each example page, especially near-duplicate filter pages
Add SearchAction to homepage WebSite schema if applicable

phases.name: Phase 4: Monitoring & Iteration
items: CI check comparing sitemap.xml against actual routes on every deploy
Track indexation of previously-missing pages in Search Console
Re-run Lighthouse/PageSpeed after adding new example pages
